Name: Alex's Sprite Edit - Wizard ( as a witch )
Author: Alexsir94
Description:
This mod only changes the Wizard's Portrait and Character sprite (.xnb)

Install [Manual]:
- Unzip or extract the folder after download
- Find your Stardew Valley folder
﻿On Steam right click Stardew Valley > Manage > Browse Local Files, in this folder go to > Content > Characters/Portraits
- Place Wizard.xnb from Female Wizard > Characters into your Stardew Valley's Characters folder and let it overwrite
- Place Wizard.xnb from Female Wizard > Portraits into your Stardew Valley's Portraits folder and let it overwrite

There is a backup of the original Wizard (.xnb-files) included if you want to revert any changes.

Inspired by:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3538]Female Wizard Potrait ( Anime version )
[/url]
[i]Mod was originally called "Alex Vanilla Female Wizard Mod"[/i]
